The changes against the current records: median -1.51 %, largest -4.06 %; 163 records improve by ≥ 1 %, 247 by ≥ 0.1 %.

**Relation to earlier submissions.** #108 and #112 were merged on 2026-11-11 and the public records rebuilt (main 1e0f6092); every record here is below the value in that archive and below the values in open submissions.

**Against PolyPack.** I also compared with PolyPack's published records (https://github.com/sinkomr/PolyPack, `data/polyhedra/records.json`, fetched 2026-11-12) and kept only records that are below both the archive and PolyPack (207 of these records have a PolyPack value; `SUMMARY.tsv` lists both values, `polypack_s`, `change_vs_best`).

**How the records were made.** `found_by`, `credit` and `method` identify where each record starts; `method` or `refinement` gives the steps.

- *Refinements of catalogue records* (1): a contact-preserving descent (sequential linear programming with the contacts as inequalities) started from the catalogue record named in `refinement` (for some, a randomised multi-start search from perturbed copies of that record comes first; `refinement` says so). `found_by`, `credit` and `method` are the catalogue record's own, copied verbatim; my part is in `refined_by` and `refinement_credit`. Rigidity analysis and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23630728
